instructions.item: General comments
instructions.quote: For every type of catastrophe risk the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles must be determined. This calculation is prospective and must be based on the reinsurance program of the next reporting year as described in the reinsurance templates for Facultative covers (S.30.01 and S.30.02) and Outgoing reinsurance program in the next reporting year (S.30.03 and S.30.04).

instructions.item: General comments
instructions.quote: The reported capital requirements reflects the capital requirements before and after risk mitigation which is the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles. The reported capital requirement after risk mitigation is before the loss absorbing capacity of technical provisions. The default value of the risk mitigation shall be reported as a positive value in order to be deducted.

instructions.item: General comments
instructions.quote: In case the diversification effect reduces the capital requirement the default value of the diversification shall be reported as a negative value.

instructions.item: Simplifications used – natural catastrophe risk
instructions.quote:
Identify whether an undertaking used simplifications for the calculation of natural catastrophe risk. The following options shall be used:
1 – Simplification for the purposes of Article 90b windstorm
2 – Simplification for the purposes of Article 90b earthquake
3 – Simplification for the purposes of Article 90b flood
4 – Simplification for the purposes of Article 90b hail
5 – Simplification for the purposes of Article 90b subsidence
9 – Simplifications not used
Options 1 to 5 may be used simultaneously.

instructions.item: SCR before risk mitigation – Natural catastrophe risk
instructions.quote: This is the total catastrophe risk before risk mitigation arising from all natural catastrophe perils and taking into consideration the diversification effect between the perils given in C0010/R0070.

instructions.item: SCR before risk mitigation – Natural catastrophe risk perils
instructions.quote:
This is the total capital requirement before risk mitigation per natural catastrophe peril, taking into consideration the diversification effect between zones and regions.
Per natural peril this amount is equal to the Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation.

instructions.item: SCR before risk mitigation – Diversification between perils
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the total capital charges before risk mitigation relating to different natural catastrophe perils.

instructions.item: Total risk mitigation – Natural catastrophe risk
instructions.quote: This is the total risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles arising from all natural catastrophe perils and taking into consideration the diversification effect between the perils given in C0020/R0070.

instructions.item: Total risk mitigation – Natural catastrophe risk perils
instructions.quote: This is the total risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles per natural catastrophe peril.

instructions.item: Total risk mitigation – Diversification between perils
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to different natural catastrophe perils.

instructions.item: SCR after risk mitigation – Natural catastrophe risk
instructions.quote: This is the total catastrophe risk after risk mitigation arising from all natural catastrophe perils and taking into consideration the diversification effect between the perils given in C0030/R0070.

instructions.item: SCR after risk mitigation – Natural catastrophe risk perils
instructions.quote:
This is the total capital requirement after risk mitigation per natural catastrophe peril, taking into consideration the diversification effect between zones and regions.
Per natural peril this amount is equal to the Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation.

instructions.item: SCR after risk mitigation – Diversification between perils
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the total capital charges after risk mitigation relating to different natural catastrophe perils.

instructions.item: Estimation of the gross premium to be earned – Other Regions
instructions.quote:
An estimate of the premiums to be earned by the insurance or reinsurance undertaking, during the following year in relation to the 14 regions other than the specified regions (include regions as specified in Annex III, except the ones specified in Annex V or in Annex XIII of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35), for the contract in relation to the obligations of lines of business, as defined in Annex I to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35 Fire and other damage covering windstorm risk, including the proportional reinsurance obligations and marine, aviation and transport insurance covering onshore property damage by windstorm, including the proportional reinsurance obligations.
Premiums shall be gross, without deduction of premiums for reinsurance contracts.

instructions.item: Estimation of the gross premium to be earned – Total Windstorm Other Regions before diversifications
instructions.quote: Total of the estimate of the premiums to be earned by the insurance or reinsurance undertaking before diversification, during the following year for the other 14 regions other than the specified regions.

instructions.item: Exposure —specified Region
instructions.quote:
The sum of the total insured per each of the 23 specified regions for lines of business, as defined in Annex I to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35:
— Fire and other damage, including the proportional reinsurance obligations, in relation to contracts that cover windstorm risk and where the risk is situated in this particular specified region; and
— Marine, aviation and transport insurance, including the proportional reinsurance obligations, in relation to contracts that cover onshore property damage by Windstorm and where the risk is situated in this particular specified region.

instructions.item: Exposure – Total Windstorm specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the exposure before diversification for the 23 specified regions.

instructions.item: Specified Gross Loss —specified Region
instructions.quote: Specified gross windstorm loss per each of the 23 specified regions, taking into consideration the effect of diversification effect between zones.

instructions.item: Specified Gross Loss – Total Windstorm specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the specified gross loss before diversification for the 23 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge Factor before risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: The risk charge factor per each of the 23 specified regions for Windstorm, taking into consideration the effect of diversification effect between zones.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge Factor before risk mitigation – Total Windstorm specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Ratio between total specified gross loss and total exposure.

instructions.item: Scenario A or B —specified Region
instructions.quote:
The larger of the capital requirement for Windstorm risk for each of the 23 specified regions according to scenario A or scenario B.
When determining the largest amount of scenario A and B, the risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, shall be taken into account.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: Capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Windstorm for each of the 23 specified Regions corresponding to the larger of scenario A or B.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Windstorm specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Windstorm for the 23 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Windstorm Other Regions before diversifications
instructions.quote: The capital requirement before risk mitigation for Windstorm risk in regions other than the specified Regions. It is the amount of the instantaneous loss, without deduction of the amounts recoverable from reinsurance contracts and Special Purpose Vehicles.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Windstorm all Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Windstorm for all regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Diversification effect between regions
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the Windstorm risks relating to the different regions (both specified Regions and ‘other regions’)

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Windstorm after diversification
instructions.quote: This is the total capital requirement before risk mitigation for Windstorm risk, taking into consideration the diversification effect reported in item C0090/R0810.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: Per each of the 23 specified Regions, the estimated risk mitigation effect, corresponding to the selected scenario, of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, excluding the estimated reinstatement premiums.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Windstorm specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated risk mitigation arising from Windstorm for the 23 specified regions.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Windstorm Other Regions before diversifications
instructions.quote: For all the regions other the specified Regions, the estimated risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, excluding the estimated reinstatement premiums.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Windstorm all Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated risk mitigation arising from Windstorm for all regions.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums —specified Region
instructions.quote: For each of the 23 specified Regions, the estimated reinstatement premiums, corresponding to the selected scenario, as a result of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Windstorm specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated reinstatement premiums for the 23 specified regions.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Windstorm Other Regions before diversifications
instructions.quote: For all the regions other than the specified Regions, the estimated reinstatement premiums, as a result of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Windstorm all Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated reinstatement premiums for all regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: Capital requirement, after the deduction of the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, arising from Windstorms in each of the specified regions, corresponding to the selected scenario.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Windstorm specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement, after the deduction of the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles for the 23 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Windstorm Other Regions before diversifications
instructions.quote: Capital requirement after risk mitigation for Windstorm risk in regions other than the specified Regions. It is the amount of the instantaneous loss, including the deduction of the amounts recoverable from reinsurance contracts and Special Purpose Vehicles.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Windstorm all Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement, after the deduction of the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles for all regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Diversification effect between regions
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the capital requirement after risk mitigations for Windstorm risks relating to the different regions (both specified Regions and ‘other regions’).

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Windstorm after diversification
instructions.quote: This is the total capital requirement after risk mitigation for Windstorm risk, taking into consideration the diversification effect given in item C0120/R0810.

instructions.item: Estimation of the gross premium to be earned – Other Regions
instructions.quote:
An estimate of the premiums to be earned by the insurance or reinsurance undertaking, during the following year in relation to each of the 14 regions other than the specified Regions (include regions as specified in Annex III, except the ones specified in Annex V or in Annex XIII of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35), for the contract in relation to the obligations of lines of business, as defined in Annex I to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35:

instructions.item: Estimation of the gross premium to be earned – Total Earthquake Other Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimate of the premiums to be earned, by the insurance or reinsurance undertaking, during the following year for the other regions.

instructions.item: Exposure —specified Region
instructions.quote:
The sum of the total insured per each of the 20 specified regions for the lines of business, as defined in Annex I to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35:
— Fire and other damage, including the proportional reinsurance obligations, in relation to contracts that cover Earthquake risk and where the risk is situated in this particular specified region; and

instructions.item: Specified Gross Loss —specified Region

instructions.item: Specified Gross Loss – Total Earthquake specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the specified gross Earthquake loss for the 20 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge Factor before risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: The Risk Charge Factor per each of the 20 specified regions for Earthquake according to the Standard Formula, taking into consideration the effect of diversification effect between zones.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge Factor before risk mitigation – Total Earthquake specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Ratio between total specified gross loss and total exposure.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: Capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Earthquakes in each of the 20 specified Regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Earthquake specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Earthquakes for the 20 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Earthquake – Other Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: The capital requirement before risk mitigation for Earthquake risk in regions other than the specified Regions. It is the amount of the instantaneous loss, without deduction of the amounts recoverable from reinsurance contracts and Special Purpose Vehicles.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Earthquake – All Regions before diversification

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Diversification effect between regions

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Earthquake after diversification

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Earthquake specified Regions before diversification

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Earthquake specified Regions before diversification

instructions.quote: Total of the estimate of the premiums to be earned, by the insurance or reinsurance undertaking, during the following year for the other regions.

instructions.item: Exposure —specified Region
instructions.quote:
The sum of the total insured per each of the 14 specified regions of lines of business, as defined in Annex I to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35:

instructions.item: Estimation of the gross premium to be earned – Total Hail Other Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimate of the premiums to be earned, by the insurance or reinsurance undertaking, during the following year for the other regions.

instructions.item: Exposure —specified Region
instructions.quote:
The sum of the total insured per each of the 11 specified regions for lines of business, as defined in Annex I to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35:
— Fire and other damage, including the proportional reinsurance obligations, in relation to contracts that cover Hail risk and where the risk is situated in this particular specified region;
— Marine, aviation and transport insurance, including the proportional reinsurance obligations, in relation to contracts that cover onshore property damage by Hail and where the risk is situated in this particular specified region; and
— Other motor insurance, including the proportional reinsurance obligations, multiplied by 5, in relation to contracts that cover onshore property damage by Hail and where the risk is situated in this particular specified region.

instructions.item: Exposure – Total Hail specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the exposure for the 11 specified regions.

instructions.item: Specified Gross Loss —specified Region
instructions.quote: Specified gross Hail loss in each of the 9 specified regions, taking into consideration the effect of diversification effect between zones.

instructions.item: Specified Gross Loss – Total Hail specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the specified gross Hail loss for the 11 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge Factor before risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: The Risk Charge Factor per each of the 11 specified regions for Hail according to the Standard Formula, taking into consideration the effect of diversification effect between zones.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge Factor before risk mitigation – Total Hail specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Ratio between total specified gross loss and total exposure.

instructions.item: Scenario A or B —specified Region
instructions.quote:
The larger of the capital requirement for Hail risk in each of the 9 specified regions according to scenario A or scenario B.
When determining the largest amount of scenario A and B, the risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, must be taken into account.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: Capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Hails in each of the 11 specified Regions corresponding to the larger of scenario A or B.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Hail specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Hails for the 11 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Hail Other Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: The capital requirement before risk mitigation for Hail risk in regions other than the specified Regions. It is the amount of the instantaneous loss, without deduction of the amounts recoverable from reinsurance contracts and Special Purpose Vehicles.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Hail All Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement before risk mitigation arising from Hails for all regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Diversification effect between regions
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the Hail risks relating to the different regions (both specified Regions and other regions).

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Hail after diversification
instructions.quote: This is the total capital requirement before risk mitigation for Hail risk, taking into consideration the diversification effect given in C0350/R1930.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: Per each of the 9 specified Regions the estimated risk mitigation effect, corresponding to the selected scenario, of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, excluding the estimated reinstatement premiums.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Hail specified Region before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated risk mitigation for the 11 specified regions.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Hail Other Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: For all the regions other than the specified Regions, the estimated risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, excluding the estimated reinstatement premiums.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Hail All Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated risk mitigation for all regions.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums —specified Region
instructions.quote: Per each of the 11 specified Regions the estimated reinstatement premiums, corresponding to the selected scenario, as a result of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Hail specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated reinstatement premiums for the 11 specified regions.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Hail Other Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: For all the regions other than the specified Regions, the estimated reinstatement premiums, as a result of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Hail All Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the estimated reinstatement premiums for all regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation —specified Region
instructions.quote: Capital requirement, after the deduction of the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, arising from Hail in each of the 11 specified Regions, corresponding to the selected scenario.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Hail specified Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement, after the deduction of the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles for the 11 specified regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Hail Other Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Capital requirement after risk mitigation for Hail risk in regions other than the specified Regions. It is the amount of the instantaneous loss, including the deduction of the amounts recoverable from reinsurance contracts and Special Purpose Vehicles.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Hail All Regions before diversification
instructions.quote: Total of the capital requirement, after the deduction of the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles for all regions.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Diversification effect between regions
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the capital requirement after risk mitigations for Hail risks relating to the different regions (both specified Regions and Other regions).

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Hail after diversification
instructions.quote: This is the total capital requirement after risk mitigation for Hail risk, taking into consideration the diversification effect given in C0380/R1930.

instructions.item: Estimation of the gross premium to be earned – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote:
An estimate of the premiums to be earned, by the insurance or reinsurance undertaking, during the following year, for the contract in relation to the obligations of fire and other damage, including the proportional reinsurance obligations.
Premiums shall be gross, without deduction of premiums for reinsurance contracts, and in relation to the territory of France.

instructions.item: Exposure – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote: The sum of the total insured made up of the geographical divisions of the territory of France for fire and other damage, including the proportional reinsurance obligations, which are sufficiently homogeneous in relation to the subsidence risk that the insurance and reinsurance undertakings are exposed to in relation to the territory. Together the zones shall comprise the whole territory.

instructions.item: Specified Gross Loss – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote: Specified gross subsidence loss, before taking into consideration the effect of diversification effect between zones.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge Factor before risk mitigation – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote: The Risk Charge Factor of the territory of France for subsidence, before taking into consideration the effect of diversification effect between zones.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote: The capital requirement before risk mitigation for Subsidence risk in the territory of France. It is the amount of the instantaneous loss, without deduction of the amounts recoverable from reinsurance contracts and Special Purpose Vehicles, which for subsidence is equal to the Specified Gross Loss (item C0410/R1950).

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Diversification effect between zones
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the Subsidence risks relating to the different zones of the territory of France.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge before risk mitigation – Total Subsidence after diversification
instructions.quote: This is the total capital requirement before risk mitigation for subsidence risk, taking into consideration the diversification effect given in item C0430/R1960.

instructions.item: Estimated Risk Mitigation – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote: The estimated risk mitigation effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, excluding the estimated reinstatement premiums.

instructions.item: Estimated Reinstatement Premiums – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote: The estimated reinstatement premiums as a result of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Subsidence before diversification
instructions.quote: Capital requirement, after the deduction of the risk mitigating effect of the undertaking’s specific reinsurance contracts and special purpose vehicles relating to this peril, arising from subsidence.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Diversification effect between zones
instructions.quote: Diversification effect arising from the aggregation of the capital requirement after risk mitigations for Subsidence risks relating to the different zones of the territory of France.

instructions.item: Catastrophe Risk Charge after risk mitigation – Total Subsidence after diversification
instructions.quote: This is the total capital requirement after risk mitigation for subsidence risk, taking into consideration the diversification effect given in item C0460/R1960.
